notes.title: Post-Gamescom Update
notes.content: Updated Build with Quality-of-Life and UI changes from Gamescom testing -- thank you everyone who tested the game!!!!

notes.title: Gamescom Public Demo
notes.content: Minor changes for public demo release

notes.title: Cost/Survival/Realistic Modes Added
notes.content: Allows you to choose a mode of gameplay that is really relaxed or a more standard survival experience

notes.title: Remapped Interact Key to E and Space + other minor fixes
notes.content: Allows for E or Space interact / firestarting in lieu of full key binding options which will come on a later build

notes.title: Patch of Fire Scenes
notes.content: Eliminates free / UI lock up after some fire conversations introduced by previous fixes. Should be solved now!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes thank you Testers!!!!
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

Scroll Wheel  + Key Press together (e.g. crouch and scroll) cause hard crash of game

Note: Bug not reproducible on my end, but a user input validation has been implemented

Where removing an upgrade and then re-adding it later would prevent items from being processed
Where build completion was dismissed by internal inventory check
Reported scaling issues

Inventory Functionality:

Disabled Right Click on Inventory slots
Reduced the time intervals on dragging items
Implemented a craft cancelation method

Inventory UI hints:

Implemented VFX on harvest UI navigation arrows
Implemented VFX on processing station UI upgrades
Changed the craft message - UI content

Timed session popup

UI improvements and additions
Timer is set to 45 minutes

Craft unlock

Selecting unlocked craft items is now mandatory
Implemented Burn-In VFX on star formation icon
Replaced the anchor to appear on top of the fire

Pause menu UI screen improvements and additions

Default map data is updated

Reduced the runtime speed for Day-Night-Cycle

Capped selecting Lore questions at one per night

Modified Stamina initialization values

notes.title: Processing Station (Sandstone, Smoker) Upgrade Fixes
notes.content: Should fix bug where adding and removing an upgrade to a station could cause the station to stop functioning

notes.title: Performance & Hint Fixes
notes.content:
- Major Performance Update -- if you have an older machine or integrated graphics machine, we'd be curious to know how it runs for you!
- Hint and Quality of Life Fixes - better hints on a few quests and tuning of some spawning to prevent you from getting stuck on a few troublesome quests

UP NEXT
- We are compiling your feedback onto a Trello board we will share, and also launching a new Map Editor contest so that maps you design can be featured in upcoming playtests

notes.title: Onboarding Fixes based on initial tests
notes.content:
More explicit onboarding of key mechanics specifically:
- Fire Fast Travel (Press and hold space)
- Fire Gift Scrolls
- Stamina System
- Required Tools for harvesting

notes.title: Map Loading Fix - Please Reinstall
notes.content:
Please reinstall if you have already installed

Due to Serialized data timestamps being rewritten automatically on upload, for some users, map data from ancient test build was being called instead of up to date data.

You should not start the game in a camp, with a large field and small lake in front of you. If you do not please kindly set a bug report and we will resolve

notes.title: Map FIx v1
notes.content: First patch addressing issue where some player receive wrong map file

notes.title: Sound Fix - Balance corrected between fire and daytime
notes.content: Thanks @John for ID'ing this -- much better balance now. Keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Stable Alpha Playtest
notes.content: 3 hours of content and four quest lines. Integrated Feedback system (via ESC menu) so please test and share your feedback to help shape the future of the game! We look forward to hearing from you :)
